name: Synn
message: "Huh? This is a pretty big change of mood from before."

name: Ria
message: "―Alright! This Tutorial Corner is here so you can enjoy tons and tons of Kuru☆Kuru battles!"

name: Synn
message: "You say battle all of a sudden, but what exactly am I supposed to do..."

name: Ria
message: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained. Everything starts with a challenge, you know\s04"

name: Synn
message: "Y-yes, ma'am!"

name: Ria
message: "So then, first... let's take a look at the battle screen."

name: Ria
message: "This is called HP. Think of it as the stamina of your allies and enemies."

name: Ria
message: "When you deal or take attacks, your HP goes down."

name: Synn
message: "So if I bring the enemy's HP to zero, that means I win?"

name: Ria
message: "Yes! Exactly right!"

name: Ria
message: "On the other hand, if an ally's HP hits zero, it's game over, so be careful."

name: Ria
message: "And this over here is the STUN gauge. It also goes down when you attack."

name: Synn
message: "What happens when these stars run out?"

name: Ria
message: "They get knocked out and can't move for a while."

name: Synn
message: "Ooh! That's a chance, isn't it!"

name: Ria
message: "Mm. But only 'the character attacked when their STUN gauge was at zero' gets knocked out, so watch out for that."

name: Synn
message: "I see. So even if an ally's STUN gauge hits zero, my senpai and I won't both be knocked out at the same time."

name: Ria
message: "Right. But knocking enemies out isn't only about attacking."

name: Synn
message: "It isn't!?"

name: Ria
message: "I'll get to that bit by bit later―"

name: Ria
message: "Next, could you take a look at this?"

name: Synn
message: "What's this...?"

name: Ria
message: "This is the EX gauge... but that's a treat for later♪"

name: Synn
message: "Don't keep me in suspense, just tell me."

name: Ria
message: "Tee hee. Being made to wait isn't so bad either, is it?"

name: Ria
message: "Next up is this. The 'Timeline', where you can see the whole battle situation at a glance. Take a look."

name: Synn
message: "Huh? There are marks for me and Ria-senpai here. Oh, and one for the demon, too."

name: Ria
message: "These marks are called 'Symbols'. They show where each character stands."

name: Ria
message: "When battle begins, these Symbols start moving leftward."

name: Synn
message: "Hm... this part labeled ACT looks like a dead end, though."

name: Ria
message: "When a Symbol reaches that ACT mark, that's when the character finally gets to act!"

name: Ria
message: "Once their action ends, they head back to the right. And then they start moving toward ACT again."

name: Synn
message: "I see... so this whole screen itself works as a time axis."

name: Ria
message: "Excellent answer!"

name: Synn
message: "And the speed of moving left is the same for both sides, enemy and ally."

name: Ria
message: "That's why, by watching this screen, you can tell 'who gets to attack first'."

name: Ria
message: "Now then, since we've finally reached ACT, let's actually try doing something!"

name: Synn
message: "Let's see... there's 'Attack' and 'Chant'. And there's one gray button, but I suppose that's off limits?"

name: Ria
message: "Righty-o. Let's learn the basic actions first\s04"

name: Synn
message: "Attack... is, literally, attacking with something called Spirit Arts."

name: Ria
message: "Mm. See the element mark here?"

name: Synn
message: "Yes. It says Darkness."

name: Ria
message: "You attack with the Spirit Art that matches this element. So Synn-kun's element is Darkness."

name: Synn
message: "Hmm hmm. So it's the so-called 'Fight' command."

name: Synn
message: "Whoa! I tried to select 'Attack' and I split into two of me!!"

name: Ria
message: "That's not a clone―it's the guide showing where you return once your action ends."

name: Synn
message: "I see... basically, 'once your action ends, you come back to this position'."

name: Ria
message: "Mm. And when you select 'Attack', next you choose a target."

name: Synn
message: "There's only one enemy right now, though..."

name: Ria
message: "Enemies won't always come one at a time, you know."

name: Synn
message: "Huh? I was choosing a target and another one appeared!? Did it call for backup!?"

name: Ria
message: "It's not reinforcements\s02 this is a guide showing how far you'll be pushed back when you attack."

name: Synn
message: "Pushed back...? So taking an attack moves you away from ACT?"

name: Ria
message: "That's right. Which means your chances to attack naturally shrink too."

name: Synn
message: "Now I tried to select Chant and... wha! I split in two again!"

name: Ria
message: "Ho~w~ma~ny~times~\s02 That's not a clone either, it's a guide."

name: Synn
message: "What is this one guiding?"

name: Ria
message: "With Chant, you raise your Spirit Power and power yourself up."

name: Ria
message: "See the Attack LV here?"

name: Synn
message: "Yes."

name: Ria
message: "That's a measure of the Spirit Power we hold. The bigger the LV, the bigger the damage."

name: Synn
message: "Ooh~~. So Chant lets me raise this Attack LV."

name: Ria
message: "Mm, clever boy♪ But Chant takes a little bit of time."

name: Synn
message: "So this guide shows how much time it will take... right?"

name: Ria
message: "Mm. And while chanting, you're defenseless―if you get attacked, it's a disaster."

name: Ria
message: "Your chant gets canceled, and you're pushed back much farther than usual."

name: Synn
message: "Powering up always comes with risk, I suppose."

name: Ria
message: "Well, just think of the guide as a way to time it right."

name: Synn
message: "Got it. I'm starting to understand, sort of."

name: Ria
message: "Then, shall we actually try it?"

name: Synn
message: "...Yes! Nothing ventured, nothing gained, after all!"

name: Ria
message: "That's the spirit♪ First, try selecting 'Attack'."

name: Synn
message: "Alright, done!"

name: Ria
message: "Splendid!"

name: Ria
message: "Look closely at the guide. The enemy reaches ACT before your chant finishes, right?"

name: Synn
message: "But I was thinking there might be times I don't get attacked..."

name: Ria
message: "Those times aren't guaranteed, so let's learn the fundamentals first, then branch out."

name: Synn
message: "O-okay"

name: Ria
message: "Then next, when it's my turn, try selecting 'Chant'."

name: Synn
message: "Hm... my push-back seemed smaller than when I did it..."

name: Ria
message: "Mm. Chant times differ from character to character."

name: Synn
message: "Ooh~~"

name: Ria
message: "For example, my chant is fast, but in exchange I take longer to return after my action ends."

name: Synn
message: "I see. Then all Ria-senpai has to do is chant nonstop!"

name: Ria
message: "That's one strategy. But honestly, I think it's more fun to try all sorts of things depending on the situation♪"

name: Ria
message: "Boo hoo... you won't listen to your senpai's request, sniff sniff"

name: Synn
message: "S-sorry! I did it on a whim..."

name: Ria
message: "Just kidding♪ In this case, choosing 'Attack' instead would have been perfectly fine."

name: Synn
message: "But chanting would deal more damage, though..."

name: Ria
message: "Then do that from the start!"

name: Synn
message: "Y-yikes~~"

name: Ria
message: "Mm. Now that's more like it!"

name: Ria
message: "Is that everything for now?"

name: Ria
message: "Want to hear this tutorial one more time?"

name: Ria
message: "Really?"

name: Synn
message: "Wow, what a clear explanation. As expected of Ria-senpai."

name: Ria
message: "Ta-dah! I am the senpai, after all♪"

name: Ria
message: "Then let's move on to live combat. It's a serious match this time, so do your best♪"

name: Synn
message: "Whoa! A Unison Attack or something just popped up!?"

name: Ria
message: "It's what you'd call a combination attack."

name: Synn
message: "A co-combination!?"

name: Ria
message: "Mm. A Unison Attack is one tactic that can deal huge damage, but..."

name: Ria
message: "Details are a treat for next time♪"

name: Synn
message: "Come o~n"

name: Ria
message: "For now, select 'Attack' and pick the Unison Leader."

name: Ria
message: "After that, choose your target, just like a normal Spirit Art attack."

name: Synn
message: "Can I chant with this too, by any chance?"

name: Ria
message: "You can, but don't come crying to me about whatever happens♪"

name: Synn
message: "Ugh, that blatant smile is scary."

name: Synn
message: "Rumble!? Wh-wh-what is this, whoa!"

name: Ria
message: "There, there, calm down. You and the enemy reached ACT at the same time, so it turned into a 'Rumble Attack'."

name: Synn
message: "What does that mean!?"

name: Ria
message: "It's a straight clash of power against power... Whoever rules the Rumble rules Kuru☆Kuru!"

name: Ria
message: "Details after CM2♪"

name: Synn
message: "That makes no sense at all."

name: Ria
message: "Anyway, try choosing the Rumble Attack leader. If you're winning on element or Attack LV, you should win the Rumble."

name: Synn
message: "Just now, didn't something zip forward?"

name: Ria
message: "Couldn't resist mashing the button at the GO timing, could you?"

name: Synn
message: "Yes. I got carried away by the rhythm, and, well..."

name: Ria
message: "That, precisely, was a Rocket Start activating♪"

name: Synn
message: "Rocket Start!?"

name: Ria
message: "If you press the button in time with the GO timing, you close in on ACT right at the start of battle."

name: Synn
message: "Th-that's how it works, huh~"

name: Ria
message: "Then it's easier to seize the initiative, see? You can attack before the enemy, so go after it hard and often to tip the battle in your favor."

name: Synn
message: "I see... this is handy!"

name: Ria
message: "Now then, straight to our first letter, from Milk Banzai-kun of Ryuusei Town♪"

name: Nanaka

message: "Now, now\s02 In exchange, the Fire, Water, and Lightning elements have stronger element effects."

name: Paqy
message: "Good thing number one about the Unison Attack!"

name: Ria
message: "On top of your normal Spirit Arts, the Unison Attack strike gets added in!"

name: Misa
message: "Which means where you could normally attack twice, you get one extra, for three attacks total."

name: Ria
message: "Exactly♪"

name: Paqy
message: "And good thing number two about the Unison Attack!"

name: Ria
message: "The Unison Attack is huge damage!"

name: Paqy
message: "And the more characters join the Unison Attack, the bigger the damage gets."

name: Misa
message: "Two, three, four... it just keeps growing, then."

name: Nanaka

message: "Though President-san is on break this time~"

name: Paqy
message: "Good thing number three about the Unison Attack!"

name: Nanaka
message: "There's still more!?"

name: Ria
message: "Actually, you can even Chant during a Unison Attack."

name: Ria
message: "And when you do, the chant time syncs to the character with the shortest chant."

name: Nanaka
message: "So if slow-chanting Misa and fast-chanting Ria-senpai chant together in a Unison Attack―"

name: Lolotte
message: "Senpai-san's chant speed is the one that applies."

name: Misa
message: "With onee-sama and...\s04"

name: Paqy

name: Nanaka

name: Lolotte
message: "But aiming for a Unison Attack requires everyone to return at the same time, so it is rather left to chance."

name: Paqy
message: "That's where 'Unison' comes in."

name: Ria
message: "When you perform this Unison, you wait right there until the ally closest to ACT arrives."

name: Misa
message: "I see... by doing that, you can deliberately trigger a Unison Attack."

name: Ria
message: "But once a Unison Attack fires, you can no longer choose Unison."

name: Paqy
message: "Also, for Unison Attacks triggered via Unison, you can't chant either, so watch it."

name: Ria
message: "And when you perform Unison, make sure no enemy is near ACT."

name: Paqy
message: "Unison leaves you defenseless, just like chanting. If the enemy attacks first, your Unison fails."

name: Nanaka
message: "So the bigger the benefit, the bigger the risk, huh."

name: Lolotte
message: "In any case, once everyone gathers at this ACT, all is solved!"

name: Ria
message: "Actually, that's not the only way to fire a Unison Attack."

name: Lolotte
message: "There's more~!?"

name: Ria
message: "See this glowing green area?"

name: Misa
message: "Yes... oh my? The one in front seems to be overlapping into this area too..."

message: "This is called the 'Unison Area'!"

name: Paqy

name: Nanaka
message: "Ooh! Then even more of us can pile into one Unison Attack!"

name: Paqy
message: "One warning, though. A Unison Attack using the 'Unison Area' requires at least two people at ACT, period."

name: Lolotte

message: "Good catch. Actually, you can deliberately trigger a Unison Attack even through chanting."

name: Paqy
message: "But unlike Unison, it won't wait forever, so this one's all about timing too."

name: Ria
message: "But your Attack LV goes up, so it works in your favor. I say aim for it aggressively."

name: Ria
message: "Mm, perfect! Now the four-person Unison Attack using the Unison Area will fire!"

name: Paqy
message: "Kukuku... the enemy's in tears."

name: Ria
message: "So that's the general idea, but..."

message: "And that concludes... Ria and"

name: Lolotte
message: "No way!?"

message: "To avoid losing, put the chanting and Unison you've learned to good use."

message: "Then it's easier to seize the initiative. You can attack before the enemy, so go after it hard and often to tip the battle your way."
